sections.title: Masters Reg Tuition
sections.description: For students writing a Master’s Thesis to fulfill the program’s requirements. All required coursework (8 CUs) must be completed prior to being enrolled; allows for a student to be enrolled full-time to work exclusively on research, writing and preparing his/her Master’s thesis and defense.
